example.title: Perry's Victory and International Peace Memorial (1915), Put-in-Bay
example.place: Put-in-Bay, South Bass Island, Ottawa County, OH

brief: The island's memorial column: a 107 m (352 ft) Doric column of pink Milford granite on a broad stepped plaza and granite terrace by the harbour, with a bronze urn-shaped observation deck and lamp on top, flagpoles along the plaza steps, and a sea wall and lawn below. Four photos. Older than 1970 (1915): the memorial is the single real example of this monument, named in the brief as the model. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

names.name: Victory Column
names.plaque: To commemorate the battle of Lake Erie and a century of peace

label: Perry's Victory Column
